purpose: Support a bounded architecture review without loading unrelated project history.

sources.selection_basis: Only the architecture sections required by the declared task class are included.
limitations: The source governs intended architecture only, not current implementation.

freshness.revalidation_method: Re-resolve every source reference and compare its exact digest and authority status.

allowed_use.rights_basis: Project-owned internal review material for the named consumer.

retention.deletion_method: Delete the derived pack after preserving only its manifest and required review evidence.

exclusions: Historical narrative and unrelated current-state material are intentionally omitted.
limitations: Repository validation cannot prove provider-side retention or deletion behavior.
non_proven_implications: Receipt of this pack does not grant action authority, establish capability, or prove project readiness.
